tldr: Venus through the 8th house softens shared money, trust, intimacy, dependency, and control.
body:
When Venus moves through your 8th house, it draws your attention toward shared money, debt, trust, intimacy, dependency, fear, grief, and what is hard to control. You may notice where trust, money, attachment, or vulnerability is carrying more weight than usual.

You may notice what feels wanted, valuable, pleasurable, attractive, or worth protecting. It can help you see what you actually want to choose, keep, enjoy, or repair.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for getting honest about what is shared, owed, feared, or avoided.

The caution: Watch for choosing the pleasant answer because the honest one would ask more of you. The risk is trying to control what actually needs a clearer agreement or a more truthful conversation.

Venus moves through this house for a few weeks. Let ease show you what you value. Just do not confuse comfort with truth.
